translations.web: ‘Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.
translations.bsb: Nevertheless, I will bring to it health and healing, and I will heal its people and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
translations.kjv: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
